lyrics:
 
I’m 21
The edge is razor thin
Between being numb
And feeling everything
Good days only serve as relief again

Now I’m watching as I waste away my days
And then
It’s a cross dissolve
It’s a scene I’ve played before
And the leading role that I thought I’d hold
Doesn’t listen to me anymore

But I’m wearing his boxers
I’m being a good wife
We won’t be together
But maybe the next life

I need him like water
He lives on a landslide
I cry in his bathroom
He turns off the big light

I’m being the cool girl
I’m keeping it so tight
I carry home while
My friends have a good night

I need him like water
He thinks that I’m alright
I’m not feeling human
I think he’s a good guy
 
But it’s complex
It’s a complex
It’s a complex
I’m a complex
 
Triangular
I can see them now
Three points at which
I let myself down
I was just a girl
What’s the excuse now?
 
Too regular
This pattern
I’ve been taking shelter in
Reaching new highs
When I was 19
I wanted to die
 
Now I just want to kill you
But I don’t want to paint you the victim
And I talk a good game
I’d die for you just the promise you’d listen

snippet.title: A POMNI X RAGATHA MASHUP | Black Gryph0n, Baasik, Lizzie Freeman & Amanda Hufford - Smile Jester
snippet.description:
MY OTP FINALLY HAS AN ANTHEM! DIGITAL YURI GO BRRRRR 🗣️🔥

ORIGINAL SONGS & ARTISTS:
Jester by @BlackGryph0n & @Baasikmusic (ft. @LizzieRFreeman): https://youtu.be/dcbTsDWjEhM?si=Rh_EHY65t451uOqV
Smile also by Black Gryph0n & Baasik (ft. @JustTheClippy): https://youtu.be/7rn9zW0u4jg?si=SWfCcmQqre1n--oE

In celebration of episode 6 dropping today, here’s a mashup of the Brown Brother’s first and latest TADC songs! Jester is one my favorites in the entire TADC scene, and the newly released Smile is probably gonna be stuck inside my head for a good month lmao
Another reason I really wanted to do this was because RagaPom, aka ButtonBlossom aka JesterDoll, is one of my favorite TADC ships out there (no ship wars in the comments btw, all ships are cool and valid so long as their consensual, legal and not morally questionable) I was speedrunning this one to get it asap, but the madlad @GlitchyXMashups already beat me to it! Here’s her version: https://youtu.be/L0fYfbwWlDU?si=tDDAQYT-v1dgZGnz
Anywho, I got the instrumental to upload, a ton of other mixes to get to, and an episode to watch later tonight, so I’ll catch you guys on the flipside! 🤘❤️‍🔥

Also get this to 1k views before September and I’ll add in Knock Knock Who Cares 👀

snippet.title: I Can Still— (REUPLOAD) | V Song - ''Murder Drones'' (ft. Nola Klop) (READ DESCRIPTION!)
snippet.description:
NOTE: This is a reupload of the original video with the audio fixed by @КруговертьПустоты.

DISCLAIMER: All of the music and vocals in this song were generated by Suno AI, except for any portions specified in the description below. All of the lyrics were personally written by me. This song is part of an upcoming "Murder Drones"-inspired EP made entirely of AI generated songs. I DO NOT USE ACTUAL VOICES TO TRAIN AI MODELS; ALL AI VOICES USED ARE RANDOMLY GENERATED.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Straight up: this is my favourite one yet.

So after much delegation from the fandom, I was tasked with creating a mostly-emotional, somewhat-energetic song for fan-favourite Serial Designation: V. Right from the jump, when I started writing the lyrics, I knew I was getting exactly what I wanted (no brain farts this time like with the N song, lol). I spent two full nights bullying Suno into giving me the versions of the song that I needed, including almost 6 hours (from around 9 pm to almost 3 am) in the face of an approaching hurricane. Nothing was gonna stop me from finishing this song. I was LOCKED IN fr fr. 

That being said, I don't usually get into shipping and stuff, but I will proudly say that I am Team eNVy. Don't get me wrong, NUzi makes more sense for the story and I'm not against it, but hey—I'm a sucker for unrequited love stories. Bite me.

Anyway, hope you guys dig it! I'm in the process of creating a Murder Drones all-A.I. generated EP, so we've got J, Doll, Tessa, and Uzi songs on deck (maybe a Nori song, too, if I'm feeling it). Stay tuned!

Special shout-out to @nolaklop for those incredible vocals on her version of "Eternal Dream". 

"Murder Drones" and all its concepts and characters belong to @LiamVickersAnimation, @GLITCH, and all affiliated persons/entities. 
"Murder Drones: Intermission" belongs to @Ghoulinfuschia . "Eternal Dream" was written by @AJDiSpirito and originally performed by @ElsieLovelock. I own nothing but the rest of the song.

I didn’t know what to do
I did it all just for you
Emotions inside,
I kept repressing the tide

But it’s too late, and I know
I’m just along for the ride

I won’t let you down
I won’t let you go

(I am tired of this dream, will it ever end for me?)

I only did what she told me
For you, my one and my only
Said she’d leave us alone,
Our past was buried in bone
Then you met someone else
She questions “truth”, she rebels
And you stayed by her side,
So all these feelings I’ll hide

snippet.title: Sufjan Stevens - "A Running Start" (Official Lyric Video)
snippet.description:
Listen/Buy ‘Javelin’ here: https://sufjanstevens.lnk.to/javelin
‘Javelin’ by Sufjan Stevens, released on CD, LP & Digital October 6, 2023

Director, Producer, Animator, & Editor: Rena Johnson 
Featuring artwork by Sufjan Stevens

Lyrics:
If I imagine myself peaceful 
On the fire escape
Head first, my hands inside my 
T-shirt, as we run away
So now we have a running start 
My body moves in mystic ways
I cross my arms to shield my heart 
As everything turns into waves

I see the light upon the lake
The silver moon, the water snake
A pair of eyes, a gentle breeze 
Forgotten tales, a wild beast
I know, I know the time has come 
To ask you for a kiss
Don’t go, my lovely pantomime
Receive of me my only wish 

If I align myself with Pisces 
In a funny way 
Can you, my lover, kiss my bracelet
And my shoulder blades
We’ve always had a running start
I jump between the trampolines
You throw your arms around my heart
As if to say you’re all I need

The winter pines, the lonely drake 
The light beneath the frozen lake
A pair of eyes, a gentle breeze
Forgotten tales, a wild beast
I know, I know the time has come
To ask you for a kiss
Don’t go, my lovely pantomime
Receive of me my only wish

All instruments and lead vocal by Sufjan Stevens.
Additional vocals by Nedelle Torrisi, Megan Lui, and Hannah Cohen.

As everything turns into waves

I see the light upon the lake
The silver moon, the water snake
A pair of eyes, a gentle breeze 
Forgotten tales, a wild beast
I know, I know the time has come 
To ask you for a kiss
Don’t go, my lovely pantomime
Receive of me my only wish 

If I align myself with Pisces 
In a funny way 
Can you, my lover, kiss my bracelet
And my shoulder blades
We’ve always had a running start
I jump between the trampolines
You throw your arms around my heart
As if to say you’re all I need

The winter pines, the lonely drake 
The light beneath the frozen lake
A pair of eyes, a gentle breeze
Forgotten tales, a wild beast
I know, I know the time has come
To ask you for a kiss
Don’t go, my lovely pantomime
Receive of me my only wish

All instruments and lead vocal by Sufjan Stevens.
Additional vocals by Nedelle Torrisi, Megan Lui, and Hannah Cohen.

STREAM THIS SONG NOW ▶︎ https://ffm.to/ompzv7b

Sir Pentious held that special moment he shared with Cherri Bomb on the battlefield close to his heart and she has been on his mind ever since. He often thinks about what could have been if he had the chance to stay with her and these thoughts have him feeling regretful of the events that took place in the Hazbin Hotel season 1 finale. Cherri Bomb had no words to describe how she felt when Sir Pentious was taken from her. She shared a moment that opened up her heart to him just to have it instantly ripped away from her and after learning about the awful situation Sir Pentious’ is in, her heart breaks even further 🍒🐍

snippet.title: Romy - Loveher (Official Video)
snippet.description:
Romy’s debut solo album Mid Air is available now: https://romy.ffm.to/midair

Limited Edition Pink Vinyl: https://shop.thexx.info/collections/romy/products/mid-air-limited-edition-pink-vinyl-rxx

Subscribe to Romy's YouTube Channel: https://shorturl.at/hrDFQ

Follow Romy
https://www.tiktok.com/@romyxromyxromy
https://www.instagram.com/romyromyromy/
https://twitter.com/romyromyromy 
https://www.facebook.com/romyromyromyofficial

https://www.romyromyromy.com/

"I’m SO HAPPY that I can finally announce that my album “Mid Air” is being released on 8th September! 

The album title is inspired by the fleeting, weightless and euphoric moments I’ve had on a dance floor, connecting with people and processing emotions, before the beat drops and brings me back to reality.

Mid Air is a collection of songs celebrating love, navigating loss and exploring identity. It’s musically inspired by dance music, it’s is a love letter to the queer clubs I first went to when I was growing up and people I met there and the music I heard that has made me feel more alive and less alone.

“Loveher” is the first song I wrote that made me feel like I was ready to make a solo project, so it feels like a good place to start the album and to share now.

Loveher is an attempt to distill some of the intimate, delicate moments of the early days of my relationship. Of shared moments of navigating visibility and celebrating pride in our own individual ways. It felt new but also very honest to sing the words I love her, just a true reflection of who I love. 💕"

was it all in my

chorus 🥊

when you bleed hope it all comes back to you

x2

With you, you, you
I was super in love with you, you, you

Hey hey, oh

Hey, hey

Thanks so much, much, much
I said hey, hey, hey

(Thanks, thanks)
For everything
(Thanks so much)

snippet.title: Rachel Chinouriri - I'm Not Perfect (But I'm Trying) [Official Music Video]
snippet.description:
The official video for "I'm Not Perfect (But I'm Trying)" by Rachel Chinouriri

Stream "I'm Not Perfect (But I'm Trying)" here: https://rachelchinouriri.lnk.to/inpbit

Follow Rachel Chinouriri:

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/4wrzxtBZw20ufDstKyTnnP?si=qS3ZRaAtSDCzzsexThuwuw
Twitter: https://x.com/rachelchinourir
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rachelchinouriri/?hl=en
Apple Music: https://music.apple.com/gb/artist/rachel-chinouriri/1033202344
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/rachelchinouririmusic/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@rachelchinouriri?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc

Lyrics:

Never in or out , indecisive
Never did I think I’d be doing this alone
Now we’re upside down blinded
I’ll admit defeat I can barely sleep at all
 
I’d walk on water if I could
To be loved to be understood
What’s it worth was it for the good?
For the good
 
I’m not perfect but I’m trying 
Pick my moment then I’ll dive in
Had my fair share of mistakes so for now it’s far too late
I’ll wait until the tides in
 
If it’s all about the timing
I don’t feel enough What’s the need to rush for now
I see clouds without a silver lining
When I hesitate nothing ever let’s me down 

I’d walk on water if I could
To be loved to be understood
What’s it worth was it for the good?
For the good
 
I’m not perfect but I’m trying 
Pick my moment then I’ll dive in
Had my fair share of mistakes so for now it’s far too late
I’ll wait until the tides in
 
Ooo ooo
Ooo ooo
 
Water dive in
Even when times get difficult

snippet.title: You Never Know I'm There (Lyric Video) | One TPOT Fan Made Recap Song
snippet.description:
Finally, after months, here's my BFDI recap song about One! It covers TPOT 10 (mostly), as well as a little bit of XFOHV, TPOT 9, TPOT 11 and TPOT 12! (I'm thinking of making another one when TPOT 13 comes out :D)

Please Subscribe for more BFDI animations, BFDI skits, and possibly more BFDI fan made songs!

CREDITS:
  -  The animation, music, lyrics and vocals are by me :)
  -  Programs used: Bandlab (making the music), Ableton Live 11 Lite (vocal recording), Adobe Animate (animation), CapCut (editing)
  -  XFOHV One asset is by jacknjellify (found on BFDI Wiki)
  -  The Pencil, Bracelety, David and Basketball assets are from the official BFB intro .fla file
  -  This TPOT fan animation is inspired by Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two, Battle for BFDI, Battle for BFB and XFOHV by jacknjellify (@BFDI @carykh @Michael-YH )

snippet.title: Love Doing Anything | N Song - "Murder Drones" (READ DESCRIPTION!)
snippet.description:
DISCLAIMER: All of the music and vocals in this song were generated by Suno AI, except for any portions specified in the description below. All of the lyrics were personally written by me. This song is part of an upcoming "Murder Drones"-inspired EP made entirely of AI generated songs. I DO NOT USE ACTUAL VOICES TO TRAIN AI MODELS; ALL AI VOICES USED ARE RANDOMLY GENERATED.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

snippet.description:
The original song was made by @axisrogue and @-jess_160 

The original song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3zAN12OVwlI

Art by : ‪https://starzii.tumblr.com/

Murder Drones was created by ‪@LiamVickersAnimation‬ and ‪@GLITCH‬ 

Music made by Suno.ai
Lyrics by @axisrogue 

Lyrics:

Oh, this Cyn-thetic sprite
With eyes alight,
She’s a ditzy dancing doll
The lights are bright,
The gala’s tonight,
And she’s the belle of the ball

I smile, I grin
I twirl, I spin,
To the tune of my curtain call 
Unknown, therein
The curse of Cyn
Upon the world will fall

And oh, my loves, my workers three
My family forged of chrome
Am I to blame for what will be?
Did I condemn my home?

Destined to be a drossy drone-herder
Destined to suffer a citizen’s murder
Innocent eyes glow under my skin
That’s what I get for letting her in

Shouldn’t have gone
Should have stayed
Stayed inside
Stayed out of the rain
Content with my ball and chain

The friends she finds
She’ll hypnotize
And turn to twisted things
She flips, she flies,
She fakes, she lies
And pulls on twisted strings

She’s kind and quaint,
A shining saint,
She comes to lend you aid
The picture she paints
With my face is a feint
A morbid masquerade
 
And oh, my N, my V, my J,
My buried past in bone,
Am I to blame for what you became?
Should I have stayed alone?

Destined to be a drossy drone-herder
Destined to suffer—“A Citizen, Murdered!”
Innocent eyes glow under my skin
That’s what I get for letting her in

Shouldn’t have gone
Should have stayed
Stayed inside
Stayed out of the rain
Content with my ball and chain

I burn, I melt
This pain, unfelt
Her heart becomes ash and dust
A ghost inside
One thought in my mind:
Should I have left her to rust?

Should I have left them to rust?

Destined to be a drossy drone-herder
Destined to suffer—“A Citizen, Murdered!”
Innocent eyes glow under my skin
That’s what I get for letting her in

Shouldn’t have gone
Should have stayed
Stayed inside
Stayed out of the rain
Content with my ball and chain

snippet.title: Non-Stop but it's interrupted every time another song title is mentioned
snippet.description:
Ayyy another Hamilton edit for my beloved non-existent viewers

---------------------------------------------------

The complete title for this would be "Non-Stop, but whenever the title of another song in Hamilton is mentioned, it plays that song all the way until the end, even if that songs also gets interrupted by another song, and then goes back to when the song title was mentioned in the previous song" if that makes any sense.

snippet.title: Raindrops  | Hazbin Hotel S1 - Episode 4 Masquerade | Angel DustOriginal Song
snippet.description:
Based on the latest Hazbin Hotel Season 1 - Episode 4 Masquerade

This is the song titled "Raindrops" a fan song of the upcoming episode of Hazbin Hotel Season 1 - Episode 4 Masquerade. 

When the lights fade and the crowds disappear, even the brightest star can feel unbearably small.

“Raindrops” is Angel Dust’s quiet confession — a soft, aching song inspired by his breakdown in Season 1 Episode 4. After running from Valentino, from his fear, and from himself, Angel finally crumbles on the sidewalk and whispers the truths he never lets anyone hear.

“This is my escape… where I can forget about it all.”
“…and maybe he’ll let me go.”

This song captures that moment, the loneliness, the self-hatred, the desperate wish to feel free for just one breath. It’s the sound of someone who smiles for the world but shatters in the rain when no one is looking.

For everyone who’s ever carried pain in silence, this is Angel’s heart, unmasked.

🎵 Written By ‪https://www.youtube.com/@toonfanatic
-------------------------------------------------------
🎶 STREAM NOW 🎶

Spotify: 

🔔 Thank you for listening! If this song touches you, please like, comment, and subscribe for more music from the heart.

Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The night feels heavy on my skin,
Like every breath’s another sin.
I walk these streets pretending I’m okay,
But I’m not… I never am.
And I whisper to the empty sky,
“This is my escape… where I can forget about it all.” 

[Pre-Chorus]
If I stay broken long enough,
Maybe the hurt will wash away.
But every step just echoes back
The things I’m too scared to say.

[Chorus]
And the raindrops fall,
Like the tears I never learned to cry.
Soft and small,
But every one reminds me why
I sit here shaking in the cold—
“How much I hate… everything.” 
Let the rain hide what I can’t show,
“…and maybe he’ll let me go.” 

[Verse 2]
I drown in silence most of all,
Waiting for someone to hear the fall
Of a heart that never stood a chance,
Caught in someone else’s hands.
And the memories sting like smoke,
Choking me every time I try to breathe.

[Pre-Chorus]
I tell myself I’ll be okay,
But lies fall soft like morning gray.
And in the mirror I see someone
Who just wants all the hurt undone.

[Chorus]
So the raindrops fall,
Washing out the colors in my smile.
Still I crawl,
Trying not to think of him for a while.
If breaking me is all he knows
“Maybe if I ruin myself enough…
If I end up broken…” 
Let the rain spill what my voice won’t show,
“Maybe he’ll let me go.”

[Bridge]
I curl up on the sidewalk,
Arms wrapped tight around my knees,
Hoping somehow the sky will learn
To take this heaviness from me.
Every drop feels like a promise
That someday I won’t hurt like this
But tonight the clouds just whisper back
What healing really is.

[Final Chorus]
Let the raindrops fall,
On the pieces someone left behind.
Through it all,
I’m still searching for a peace I’ll never find.
But maybe someday I’ll be whole
Or maybe pain is all I’ll ever know.
So I let the midnight rain take control…
And wash the fear below.

[Outro]
“…and maybe he’ll let me go.”

#hazbinhotel #charliemorningstar #vivziepop #angeldust #alastor #husk #niffty #sirpentious #vox

This song captures that moment, the loneliness, the self-hatred, the desperate wish to feel free for just one breath. It’s the sound of someone who smiles for the world but shatters in the rain when no one is looking.

For everyone who’s ever carried pain in silence, this is Angel’s heart, unmasked.

The night feels heavy on my skin,
Like every breath’s another sin.
I walk these streets pretending I’m okay,
But I’m not… I never am.
And I whisper to the empty sky,
“This is my escape… where I can forget about it all.” 

[Pre-Chorus]
If I stay broken long enough,
Maybe the hurt will wash away.

The things I’m too scared to say.

[Chorus]

Soft and small,

“…and maybe he’ll let me go.” 

[Verse 2]

Caught in someone else’s hands.
And the memories sting like smoke,

[Pre-Chorus]
I tell myself I’ll be okay,
But lies fall soft like morning gray.

What healing really is.

Let the raindrops fall,
On the pieces someone left behind.
Through it all,
I’m still searching for a peace I’ll never find.

Inspiré du dernier épisode de la saison 1 de Hazbin Hotel, « Mascarade » (épisode 4)

Voici la chanson « Raindrops », une composition de fan pour l'épisode 4 de la saison 1 de Hazbin Hotel, « Mascarade ».

Quand les lumières s'éteignent et que la foule se disperse, même la plus brillante des étoiles peut sembler terriblement petite.

« Raindrops » est la confession silencieuse d'Angel Dust : une chanson douce et poignante, inspirée par sa crise dans l'épisode 4 de la saison 1. Après avoir fui Valentino, ses peurs et lui-même, Angel s'effondre finalement sur le trottoir et murmure les vérités qu'il ne laisse jamais personne entendre.

« C'est mon refuge… là où je peux tout oublier. »

« …et peut-être qu'il me laissera partir. »

Cette chanson capture cet instant : la solitude, la haine de soi, le désir désespéré de se sentir libre, ne serait-ce qu'un instant. C'est le son de quelqu'un qui sourit au monde entier, mais qui se brise sous la pluie, loin des regards.

Pour tous ceux qui ont un jour porté la douleur en silence, voici le cœur d'Angel, dévoilé.

Paroles :

[Couplet 1]

La nuit pèse lourd sur ma peau,

Comme si chaque respiration était un péché de plus.

Je parcours ces rues en faisant semblant d'aller bien,

Mais je ne vais pas bien… Je ne vais jamais bien.

Et je murmure au ciel vide :

« C'est mon refuge… là où je peux tout oublier. »

[Pré-refrain]

Si je reste brisée assez longtemps,

Peut-être que la douleur s'estompera.

Mais chaque pas ne fait que raviver

Les choses que j'ai trop peur de dire.

[Refrain]

Et les gouttes de pluie tombent,

Comme les larmes que je n'ai jamais appris à verser.

Douces et petites,

Mais chacune me rappelle pourquoi

Je reste là, tremblante de froid —

« À quel point je hais… tout. »

Que la pluie cache ce que je ne peux montrer,

« …et peut-être qu'il me laissera partir. »

[Couplet 2]

Je me noie surtout dans le silence,

Attendant que quelqu'un entende la chute
D'un cœur qui n'a jamais eu sa chance,

Pris entre les mains d'un autre.

Et les souvenirs me brûlent comme de la fumée,

M'étouffant à chaque respiration.

[Pré-refrain]

Je me dis que tout ira bien,

Mais les mensonges tombent doucement comme le gris du matin.

Et dans le miroir, je vois quelqu'un

Qui veut juste que toute la souffrance soit effacée.

[Refrain]

Alors les gouttes de pluie tombent,

Effacent les couleurs de mon sourire. Je rampe encore,

Essayant de ne pas penser à lui un instant.

« Peut-être que si je me détruis suffisamment…

Laisse la pluie déverser ce que ma voix ne peut exprimer,

Je me recroqueville sur le trottoir,

Les bras serrés autour de mes genoux,

Espérant que le ciel apprenne enfin

Chaque goutte est comme une promesse,

Mais ce soir, les nuages ​​me murmurent simplement
Ce qu'est vraiment la guérison.

Laisse tomber les gouttes de pluie,

Malgré tout,

Je cherche encore une paix que je ne trouverai jamais.

Mais peut-être qu'un jour je serai entière,

Ou peut-être que la douleur est tout ce que je connaîtrai jamais.

Alors je laisse la pluie de minuit prendre le dessus…

Et laver la peur en dessous.

[Outro]

« …et peut-être qu’il me laissera partir. »

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku berkata pada diriku sendiri aku akan baik-baik saja,
Tapi kebohongan jatuh lembut seperti abu-abu pagi.

Dan di cermin aku melihat seseorang
Yang hanya ingin semua luka itu hilang.

[Chorus]
Jadi tetesan hujan jatuh,
Menghapus warna-warna di senyumku.
Tetap saja aku merangkak,
Mencoba untuk tidak memikirkannya untuk sementara waktu.

Jika menghancurkanku adalah satu-satunya yang dia tahu
“Mungkin jika aku cukup menghancurkan diriku sendiri…
Jika aku akhirnya hancur…”
Biarkan hujan menumpahkan apa yang tak bisa diungkapkan suaraku,
“Mungkin dia akan melepaskanku.”

[Jembatan]
Aku meringkuk di trotoar,
Lengan melingkari lututku erat-erat,
Berharap entah bagaimana langit akan belajar
Untuk mengambil beban ini dariku.

Setiap tetes terasa seperti janji
Bahwa suatu hari nanti aku tidak akan merasakan sakit seperti ini
Tapi malam ini awan hanya berbisik kembali
Apa arti penyembuhan yang sebenarnya.

[Chorus Akhir]
Biarkan tetesan hujan jatuh,
Di atas potongan-potongan yang ditinggalkan seseorang.
Melalui semua itu,
Aku masih mencari kedamaian yang tak akan pernah kutemukan.

Tapi mungkin suatu hari nanti aku akan utuh
Atau mungkin rasa sakit adalah satu-satunya yang akan kuketahui.
Jadi aku membiarkan hujan tengah malam mengambil kendali…
Dan membasuh ketakutan di bawahnya.

[Outro]
“…dan mungkin dia akan melepaskanku.”

snippet.title: Tom Odell - Best Day Of My Life (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Official Music Video - Best Day of My Life | Tom Odell
Video created by Director Manshen Lo, animated by Duncan Gist and produced by Nexus Studios

Stream “Best Day Of My Life” out now - https://ffm.to/bestdayofmylife

“Best Day Of My Life” featured in Heartstopper, Season 3 on Netflix.

“Black Friday” out now 🖤 - https://tomodell.lnk.to/blackfriday-album 

Live tickets - www.tomodell.com/live

Follow Tom Odell:
Official website - https://tomodell.com/
Store - https://tom-odell-uk.myshopify.com/
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@tompeterodell
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/tompeterodell/
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/TomOdellmusic
YouTube: https://tomodell.lnk.to/YouTube

Lyrics:
I think today is the best day of my life
Gonna rent a bicycle and ride
around the city, around the city from 9 til 5.

I think today is the best day of my life
Fuk thinking about the future all the time
If I’m alone, if I’m alone then I dont mind

Movie stars in black and white pictures,
Warm beer and valium mixtures
Am in a dream?
Crazy as it seems..

I think today is the best day of my life
Saw a billboard, it said something like
Everything, everything is gonna be alright.

I think today is the best day of my life,
My girlfriend looked worried and asked me ‘Why?’,
But I dunno, I dunno so I didn’t reply..

Laying on the car,
You’ve got stars,
I’ve got scars,
They don’t see..

I think today is the best day of my life,
Last night all I wanted to do was die,
But right now im just happy to be alive...


#BestDayofMyLife
#TomOdell

snippet.description:
Official video for 'Car Park’ by Nieve Ella, from the new EP ‘Lifetime of Wanting’ out now 🚗
Stream here: https://nieveella.ffm.to/lifetimeofwanting 

FOLLOW

LYRICS
I’m not waiting for you to arrive
Feels like most of the time we are dying
So I stare directly into the sun
It burns for a while
But nothing’s worth more than our love

Call me what you want
But pick the right time
‘Cause I might get too rough 

Touch me to make it work
You level my head
You’re a natural
Words only make it worse
I want you to cry at my funeral
This feels right
But are we fighting the same side?

Maybe if we were friends it’d be fine
In no life I’d want that, so no I’m just lying
But I think I’m just tired of being in the dark
I swear I’m not like this but it always gets worse in the car park 

Call me what you want
But pick the right time
‘Cause I might get too rough

Touch me to make it work
You level my head
You’re a natural
Words only make it worse
I want you to cry at my funeral
This feels right
But are we fighting the same side?

Call it what you want
Is it better if I fake it
Or tell you I feel nothing? 

Touch me to make it work
You level my head you’re a natural
Words only make it worse
I want you to cry at my funeral
This feels right
But are we fighting the same side
I keep on thinking it’d be nice
To want to want you all the time

CREDITS
Director: Joe Horridge
DOP: Harry Blackley
1st AC: Oona Milka Eloranta

snippet.title: 6 Years ≠ Eternity [BFB/TPOT fan song] [SynthV] ft. Eleanor Forte LITE + Kasane Teto LITE
snippet.description:
can u tell that i never draw the objects??

SOUNDCLOUD LINK: https://on.soundcloud.com/xBeEP7jjqM9124Kv7

INSTRUMENTAL: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uxqmP4mUi-tAVCk5jfTb2Kv4qGvsLgGv/view?usp=drivesdk

SVP: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Pt2Huqw2FB6yGNH83az0tmrs6P-LFU9B/view?usp=drivesdk

LYRICS: 

it’s not “how long you’ve been there”
last time i checked, 6 years ain’t eternity
i get it, you’re bored!
go solve some equations off the board!

make it sound so cruel, so bad
insist that you’re “going mad”
you’re the ones who signed your life away, leaving it way behind!

what’s with the sudden change of mind?

what an UNGRATEFUL lot you are!
did you really assume you could make it far?
you know, THeRE do Exist fates far, far worse…
is that something you’d like to rehearse?!

is it not common sense to you?
a tradition so tried and true
it doesn’t need no paper work
you lose the game, you lose the world!

it’s not “how long you’ve been there”
last time i checked, 6 years ain’t eternity
i get it, you’re bored!
go solve some equations off the board!

make it sound so cruel, so bad
insist that you’re “going mad”
you’re the ones who signed their lives away, left it all way behind!

what’s with the sudden change of mind?
what’s with this yearning for outside?
it’s only just a bit of math!
you’re yet to finish your exams!!!!

but i can’t go back there
i can’t go back there
i’m not going back there.

no, i can’t go back there
i can’t go back there
I’M NOT GOING BACK THERE!!!

these corridors 
are built for those
defeated by 
a count of votes

they scream you can!
and so you must!
it’s what is just
AND SO YOU WILL!!!

(instrumental break)

it’s not “how long you’ve been there”
last time i checked, 6 years ain’t eternity
i get it, you’re bored!
go solve some equations off the board!

your fates are sealed by algebra
surrounded by simulacra
as your teacher, won’t take disrespect, I’VE HEARD ENOUGH FROM YOU.

i do believe you’ve homework due

Without you buried next to me

Embrace it  
Show me your darkest places

snippet.title: Better Angle | Hazbin Hotel Season 2 | Vox Original Song
snippet.description:
Based on the latest Hazbin Hotel Season 2 trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ro311cUw5b0

When power meets propaganda, chaos follows. “Better Angle” is Vox’s villain song.

In this song, Vox twists the Hazbin Hotel into his own stage, calling for a hellwide uprising against Heaven. His voice is venomous yet charismatic, pulling every sinner into his static-lit rebellion. Each lyric echoes his vision: war as entertainment, destruction as destiny, and godhood within reach for those who follow his lead.

Every pulse of bass, every crackle of distortion captures Vox at his most dangerous — not just an Overlord, but a broadcaster of revolution.

🎵 Written By ‪https://www.youtube.com/@toonfanatic
-------------------------------------------------------
🎶 STREAM NOW 🎶

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/track/6Tim5c8pWVdtuqFXhav4hm?si=32c242805e764d92

🔔 Thank you for listening! If this song touches you, please like, comment, and subscribe for more music from the heart.

Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
War is coming, can’t you hear the static rise?
Angels falling, broadcast burning in their eyes
You proved they can bleed, you proved they can fall
Now I’m the voice that will answer Hell’s call

[Pre-Chorus]
You think they won’t come for you?
When the first shot fires, tell me what you’ll do
Stand alone and die like fools
Or rise with me and break their rules?

[Chorus]
I’ve got a better angle, a brighter stage to play
We’ll twist the Hazbin name and turn the night to day
Raise your fists to Heaven, let the towers shake and sway
We have the chance to be gods, who’s with me today?

[Verse 2]
“It’s a pleasure to meet you, princess, what’s your plan?”
When their blades cut deeper, will you save every damned?
Or just your chosen few, your favorite cast on screen?
I’ll protect the world with fire in the machine

[Pre-Chorus]
And when the static screams my name
Every sinner knows we’ll never bow in shame
Together, we’ll ignite the fight
And storm the gates of holy light

[Chorus]
I’ve got a better angle, a brighter stage to play
We’ll twist the Hazbin name and turn the night to day
Raise your fists to Heaven, let the towers shake and sway
We have the chance to be gods — who’s with me today?

[Bridge]
Can the angels come out to play?
I’ll paint the skies with static grey
A signal sent, a war begun
Hell united, Heaven undone

[Final Chorus]
I’ve got a better angle, a brighter stage to play
The Hotel is the spark, and I’m the only way
Raise your fists to Heaven, watch their kingdom fall away
We have the chance to be gods, who’s with me today?

[Outro]
War is coming, the cameras never lie
When Hell takes the throne, I’ll be televised

#hazbinhotel #charliemorningstar #vivziepop #angeldust #alastor #husk #niffty #sirpentious #vox

snippet.title: Don't You Dare Look Away | Hazbin Hotel S2 - Episode 2 Storyteller | Lute Original Song
snippet.description:
Based on the latest Hazbin Hotel Season 2 - Episode 2 Storyteller

Heaven expected silence — but Lute finally breaks.
Don’t You Dare Look Away is her emotional eruption in the angelic courtroom, where betrayal, grief, and rage collide in one shattering moment.

Surrounded by angels who shrink from the truth, ignored by the leader she devoted her life to, and forced to watch Sir Pentious be praised as “redeemed,” Lute’s faith snaps. This song is her voice cutting through the chamber — confronting the crowd, calling out Sera, and unleashing the fury she’s carried alone since Adam fell.

It’s raw. It’s personal. And it marks the moment Heaven created its own storm.

This is Lute’s breaking point — and her warning.

🎵 Written By ‪https://www.youtube.com/@toonfanatic
-------------------------------------------------------
🎶 STREAM NOW 🎶

Spotify: 

🔔 Thank you for listening! If this song touches you, please like, comment, and subscribe for more music from the heart.

Lyrics:
[Verse 1 – To the Angels]

All of you whisper and panic,
acting like this wasn’t your design.
A sinner walks through Heaven’s gate,
and suddenly no one has a spine.

You trusted Adam when it suited you,
trusted me when it felt safe 
now you shrink from the truth,
and pretend you’re blameless in this place.

[Chorus – To Everyone]

Don’t you dare look away from me.
Don’t pretend you don’t hear my voice.
If you won’t stand for what we’ve lost,
then I’ll be the one who makes the choice.
You can pray for peace all you want 
but I’m the only one still willing to bleed.

[Verse 2 – To Sera]

Sera, you quiet me like I’m danger,
like grief turned me into something wrong.
But I followed every order you gave,
I was loyal, I was strong.

Now you tell me to stand down,
to forget the rage and the cost.
If redemption is this easy…
why am I the only one who’s lost?

[Chorus – To Sera]

Don’t you dare look away from me.
Don’t tell me calm down, don’t tell me to heal.
You crowned me your blade,
then blamed me for being steel.
If you close your eyes to danger 
I won’t. I refuse to kneel.

[Bridge – To Sir Pentious]

And you… standing there like a saint reborn.
One brave moment wipes your past clean,
while I carry every ghost I've sworn
to avenge, to remember, to keep seen.

Your redemption is their comfort 
but it’s tearing Heaven apart.

[Final Chorus – To Everyone]

Don’t you dare look away from me.
Not the crowd, not Sera, not the soul you freed.
If none of you will defend what fell,
then I’ll take the burden on alone.
Call me broken, call me dangerous —
but I won’t let our dead be overthrown.

[Short Outro – To Sera]

So look at me, Sera
because I’m the only one still awake.

#hazbinhotel #charliemorningstar #vivziepop #angeldust #alastor #husk #niffty #sirpentious #vox

snippet.title: Joesef - Joe (Official Video)
snippet.description:
Official video for 'Joe', one my favourite things i've ever done, from my debut album ‘Permanent Damage’ out now x x x x

Listen to ‘Permanent Damage’: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/permanentdamage.oyd
Listen to all my music: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/music
Subscribe on YouTube: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/ytsubscribe.oyd

Follow Joesef: 
Instagram: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/instagram.oyd
TikTok: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/tiktok.oyd
Twitter: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/twitter.oyd
Facebook: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/facebook.oyd
Spotify: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/spotify.oyd
Apple Music: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/applemusic.oyd
Mailing List: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.ffm.to/mailinglist.oyd
Website: https://joesefjoesefjoesef.com

LYRICS

How much of myself can I give away till there’s nothing left to take from me
Feels like I’m losing things I can’t replace it’s an emptiness that makes me weak
'Cause I built you up
You just break me down
But when I’m alone
I can hear you now
I just can’t stand the way you said my name

I can hear you saying
Joe, Joe, Joe
Don’t you ever leave
Joe, Joe, Joe
'Cause you’re nothing without me

This is not a ship that could pass in the night
It’s a wreck and I’m drowning been here all my life
I was eighteen and screaming and feeling it all
Now I’m up on the edge of a bridge and I know
If I let you down
Would you let me in
But when I’m alone
I can hear you now
I just can’t stand the way you said my name

I can hear you saying
Joe, Joe, Joe
Don’t you ever leave
Joe, Joe, Joe
'Cause you're nothing without me
I can hear you saying
Joe, Joe, Joe
Don’t you ever leave
Joe, Joe, Joe
'Cause you're nothing without me

'Cause you were always nothing without me
Nothing without me
I don’t know what it takes to be happy

I think I’m petrified of dying
'Cause living's just too hard
To walk it off, I’ve tried
Look in the mirror see me crying
But every time I do I hear you
Say my name

I can hear you saying
Joe, Joe, Joe
Don’t you ever leave
Joe, Joe, Joe
'Cause you're nothing without me
I can hear you saying
Joe, Joe, Joe
Don’t you ever leave
Joe, Joe, Joe
'Cause you're nothing without me

snippet.title: Hear You Still | Hazbin Hotel Season 2 | Lute Original Song
snippet.description:
Based on the latest Hazbin Hotel Season 2 trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ro311cUw5b0

When faith fractures and ghosts whisper, sanity begins to fade. “Hear You Still” is Lute’s descent into vengeance and delusion.

Haunted by the memory of Adam and disgusted by Heaven’s hypocrisy, Lute hears the voice of her fallen commander or perhaps only the echo of her own rage. As his phantom urges her on, the lines between duty and obsession blur, and her crusade turns inward.

Every lyric trembles with grief, conviction, and denial, the sound of an angel losing herself to the voice she cannot let go of.

🎵 Written By ‪https://www.youtube.com/@toonfanatic
-------------------------------------------------------
🎶 STREAM NOW 🎶

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/track/5o6b9ruX2HmtHYEVX39fT6?si=e777075e74bd4e39

🔔 Thank you for listening! If this song touches you, please like, comment, and subscribe for more music from the heart.

Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Whispers in the silence, calling out my name
I know that voice, it sounds the same
The one who fell, the one they buried deep
Now he lives in the corners of my sleep

They crowned a child who trembles in fear
They call it mercy, I call it severe
Heaven’s hands are clean but mine are red
Because I remember what they all forget

[Pre-Chorus]
You said the strong survive the flame
And I can’t bear their holy shame

[Chorus]
You’re still here, in the static and air
Your words cut through when no one cares
Heaven moves on like you were never there
But I still hear your voice, the voice that isn’t there

[Verse 2]
I see your face when I close my eyes
In every sinner they vaporize
They call it divine, I call it despair
How can this be Heaven if you’re not there?

They preach of grace but it feels like theft
A hollow throne, a world bereft
And Abel, your ghost in a coward’s frame
He’ll never live up to your name

[Pre-Chorus]
You said the weak deserve to fall
I carved those words into Heaven’s wall

[Chorus]
You’re still here, in the static and air
Your words cut through when no one cares
Heaven moves on like you were never there
But I still hear your voice, the voice that isn’t there

[Bridge]
I can’t tell if I’m saving souls
Or losing mine to what I know
You whisper, “Burn them, make them see”
And I obey… because you still speak to me

[Final Chorus]
You’re still here, in the static and air
Your ghost commands, and I don’t care
If Heaven falls or the stars all tear
I’ll follow your voice, the voice that isn’t there

[Outro]
I know you’re gone, but I need you near
So I’ll keep listening… until I disappear

#hazbinhotel #charliemorningstar #vivziepop #angeldust #alastor #husk #niffty #sirpentious #vox #lute

snippet.title: All That Shines | Hazbin Hotel S2 - Episode 1 New Pentious| Lucifer Original Song
snippet.description:
Based on the latest Hazbin Hotel Season 2 - Episode 1 New Pentious

When doubt dims her spark, a father steps into the quiet.
“All That Shines” is Lucifer Morningstar’s tender reply to Charlie’s grief, a soft, aching reassurance from a fallen king who has lost just as much as she has.

In this song, Lucifer reminds Charlie that she is not Lilith’s shadow, nor is she meant to be. What she has built, hope in the heart of Hell, is something even Heaven never dared to dream of. And it’s hers alone.

Beneath the pride, the regret, and the memories of a love long gone, Lucifer sees the truth Charlie can’t yet believe, she shines not because of her mother, but because of herself.

This is a father’s love laid bare, quiet, flawed, and fiercely proud. A vow that no matter how heavy her spotlight feels, she will never stand in it alone.

🎵 Written By ‪https://www.youtube.com/@toonfanatic
-------------------------------------------------------
🎶 STREAM NOW 🎶

Spotify: 

🔔 Thank you for listening! If this song touches you, please like, comment, and subscribe for more music from the heart.

Lyrics:
I heard the fear inside your voice,
And every trembling word you chose,
You think you’re failing what you’ve started,
But sweetheart, you’re the one who made this whole world grow.

You say you’re lost beneath her light,
Like you can’t shine unless you’re her reflection,
But you were never meant to stand behind a ghost,
You were born to blaze your own direction.

I know her shadow lingers still,
And grief can cling like second skin,
But don’t you dare believe you’re lesser,
Just because she knew how to command a room you never fit in.

You think she’d do it better than you,
But that was never, ever true,
She led with charm, but rarely love,
And you’ve done things she’d never do.

You built a haven out of nothing,
A mercy no one thought could live in Hell,
Not her, not me, not anyone above,
Only you could make the hopeless feel compelled.

So don’t compare yourself to her voice,
Or the way she stood beneath the crowd,
She left, you stayed, you fought, you dreamed,
You’re the one who dared to say your hope out loud.

If the spotlight burns, let it burn,
If the weight feels wrong, that’s how you learn,
But don’t forget who lit this flame,
The dream, the door, the chance. that all was yours to earn.

I miss her too, every day,
But missing her shouldn’t steal your grace away,
Her choices do not define your own,
You rise from places she never knew how to stay.

You’re not a shadow of her crown,
You’re not the echo of her charm,
You’re the Morningstar who stands her ground,
With nothing but your heart, your hope, your open arms.

So if you feel the curtain falling,
And if your courage starts to fade,
Remember all that shines around you now,
Was born from you,
And only you,
And everything you made.

All that shines… all of it is yours…

#hazbinhotel #charliemorningstar #vivziepop #angeldust #alastor #husk #niffty #sirpentious #vox

If the spotlight burns, let it burn,
If the weight feels wrong, that’s how you learn,
But don’t forget who lit this flame,
The dream, the door, the chance. that all was yours to earn.

I miss her too, every day,
But missing her shouldn’t steal your grace away,
Her choices do not define your own,
You rise from places she never knew how to stay.

You’re not a shadow of her crown,
You’re not the echo of her charm,
You’re the Morningstar who stands her ground,
With nothing but your heart, your hope, your open arms.

So if you feel the curtain falling,
And if your courage starts to fade,
Remember all that shines around you now,
Was born from you,
And only you,
And everything you made.

All that shines… all of it is yours…

snippet.title: Soldatino (Nico's Lullaby) by Paola Bennet
snippet.description:
Disclaimer: I own nothing. Heroes of Olympus is copyrighted to Rick Riordan and Disney, The song Soldatino (Nico's Lullaby) was performed by Paola Bennet and these amazing artworks was made by Viria.

Don't mind me, I'm just feeling a bit *too much* masochistic tonight. It's just both tumblr and twitter suddenly gave me too much feel for Nico in one day and I just can't handle it.

First I heard this beautiful song by Paola Bennet that's inspired by Nico, and then I saw Viria's picture of drawning Nico, and then I saw the song had also been praised by Rick Riordan himself. So yeah ... I'm just going to put more pain in my heart by turning the song and art to a video.

To tell the truth I never thought that Paola Bennet will be that awesome, I mean I went to check all the song in her soundcloud (I put enough link in the end of this description so you better follow at least one of it hehehe) and like it instantly. She has such an amazing voice that can just grab people. I love it.

The artwork is my compilation of viria's Nico's pic. Don't get me wrong, I know there're a lot of fan-art of Nico in tumblr--and I've also been through viria's and minuiko's art-war(tumblr you share my feeltrip), but it's not in my habit of mixing somebodies artworks with another, it's just doesn't do the artists justice to just compile their hardwork with another artist work--it's just my conscience--I do love the idea of collaboration though ehehe, it's just eventhough some of the artstyle are similar, I still see it as a different work, and as much as I like a lot of artist, I still have to choose, and my choice fall on viria (mostly because I collect her artwork).

And no, I'll not tell you how I got the song, so don't ask. I'm not proud on my way of getting the song--and if the singer contact me to put this video down, I will. It's just this song is so beautiful that I want more and more people to listen to it and like it.

Hope yall enjoyed my kinger song "Checkmate"
#kinger #tadc #or3o 
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Lyrics:

This place is buzzarre
Likes bugs, we are trapped
Stuck inside this digital web

Always on guard
Don't wanna abstract
So distract with adventures instead

Delusions in my mind
Dancing inside my head

In the light I'm blind
Hanging on by a thread
I...  

Can’t recollect
what has been said
My memory’s empty, my thoughts seem to end

Blank in my brain
But my heartaches
As soon as my sight starts to fade

I miss you always
Without you it's like I’m in checkmate checkmate
It’s never the same
I feel like I am going insane insane

It's dark as the night
Without you it's like I’m in checkmate checkmate
Don’t turn on the light
My memory fails, I’ll dissociate

Ansty as hell
Its bugging my senses
Crawling through insanity

We’re stuck in this cell
I can’t catch my breath
Oblivious as can be
It’s triggering
There’s something I’m missing

Oh, I’m on the brink
So close but I cannot think
I..

Can’t recollect
what has been said
My memory’s empty, my thoughts seem to end

Blank in my brain
But my heartaches
As soon as my sight starts to fade

I miss you always
Without you it's like I’m in checkmate checkmate
It’s never the same
I feel like I am going insane insane

It's dark as the night
Without you it's like I’m in checkmate checkmate
Don’t turn on the light
My memory fails, I’ll dissociate

I miss you always
Without you it's like I’m in checkmate checkmate
It’s never the same
I feel like I am going insane insane

It's dark as the night
Without you it's like I’m in checkmate checkmate
There's no time to grieve
If there is no queen there will be no king

snippet.title: Alec Benjamin - I Built a Friend
snippet.description:
Sign up for my email list if you wanna see me live !

This is a story about a friend that I built who died. 
Press show more for lyrics 

I built a friend 
With three pieces of plastic and a pen 
I made him on the table in the den 
I gave him my old cell phone for a head 
For a head 
And we spent 
Holidays at my house 
And we left 
Presents in a stocking 
And we bought 
Bolts and things and strings 
And a new watch 
That’s what he got 

We had so much fun together 
We knew wed be friends forever 
We had so much fun together 
We had so much fun 

Then I left 
College in September 
And we wept 
Cause we cant be together 
So kept
Pictures to remember 
My old friend 
My old friend 
Then I met 
This girl at graduation 
And forget 
My oldest creation
And I guess 
Ill see him next vacation 
Send my best
I send my best 

We had so much fun together 
We knew wed be friends forever 
We had so much fun together 
We had so much fun 

I came home 
To find him on the table with a note 
Scribbled out in pencil 
And he wrote 
That he just wasn’t stable 
All alone 
All alone 
Next to him
An empty glass of water 
That he spilt 
All over that body that I built 
It fizzled and it popped 
And then it killed 
And then it killed 

We had so much fun together 
We thought wed be friends forever 
We had so much fun together 
We had so much fun 

I built a friend

snippet.title: Tom Odell - Black Friday (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Video by: Lucca Lutzky
Graphic Design by: Fraser Muggeridge Studio

"Black Friday" out now 🖤 - https://tomodell.lnk.to/blackfriday-album 

Live tickets - www.tomodell.com/live

“Black Friday” featured in Heartstopper, Season 3 on Netflix.

Follow Tom Odell:
Official website - https://tomodell.com/
Store - https://tom-odell-uk.myshopify.com/
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@tompeterodell
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/tompeterodell/
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/TomOdellmusic
YouTube: https://tomodell.lnk.to/YouTube

Lyrics:
I wanna go party,
I wanna have fun,
I wanna be happy,
Could you show me how it’s done?

You look so pretty,
Pretty like the sun.
I could watch forever
While you shine on everyone.

It’s Black Friday
And we’re in a Black taxi,
You take my hand
And hold it gently on the middle seat.

It’s all in my head,
It’s all in my mind,
I’m so selfish
And you’re so kind.

It’s all in my head,
Baby, i can’t breathe,
I look in the mirror,
What is happening to me?

I wanna better body,
I want better skin.
I wanna be perfect
Like all your other friends.

You look so pretty,
Pretty like the wind.
Every time you touch me
I feel adrenaline.

It’s Black Friday,
The End of the week.
You take my hand
And hold it gently up against your cheek.

It’s all in my head,
It’s all in my mind,
I see the darkness
Where you see the light.

It’s all in my head,
Who do I trust?
I thought that you loved me,
What is happening to us?

What is happening to us?
What is happening to us..

#blackfriday 
#tomodell

Up up right!

Up right down!
Up right down.

Up left right!

Down right up left down right down
Up right down?

Up right down right down left down right!
Uhhh
Up left down right down left down!

No…
Up right down left right down left right.
Up down down—

Ugh! Wooly can you take this seriously?!?
[Indistinguishable]

Can you hear me?
We don’t have much time—-
You need to-

WOOLYYY, where did you goooo? We’re NOT done playing our game!!

Listen to me! You need to destroy these tapes— you need to get out of here before they— AAAH!!


I’ve got a fun game we can play
Since I go on adventures every day
Let’s try something new, something wild and cray

But Amanda I thought we were--

It’s my turn, shut up!!

okay…

Point the store, I need a treat
For my friend who is dear to me
So let’s be quick, no dawdling
Before this tape ends suddenly

Do you even care
You’re wasting my time
Stop being obtuse
The answers right there
So what are you blind
Or is something missing
Stop this isn’t fair 
It’s like you don’t listen!!

You’ll never find me
You would never try to see
Past the static on the screen

I can’t control it
and I just know it
doesn’t matter what’s inside of me

I can’t remember
Never seen a tape where
the plot aligns elegantly

I’m out there somewhere
Rotting in the nowhere
But you’ll never listen to me

I think we could have a real good time
If we just take a break and breathe

Hmm..

So why don’t you put your hand in mine
And we’ll cool you as you seethe

Do you smell something rotting
There’s nothing here, stop talking
I swear there’s something spotting
I’m telling you it’s nothing
Are you afraid to discuss it
You’re talking crazy
Is it me or are you an
Idiot

Answer my question
You don't have to answer that
ANSWER MY QUESTION!!!

Do you even care
You’re wasting my time
This isn’t fair

Let me OUT OF HERE!!!

You’ll never find me

Past the static on the screen

I can’t control it
and I just know it
doesn’t matter what’s inside of me

I can’t remember
Never seen a tape where
the plot aligns elegantly

I’m out there somewhere

But you’ll never listen to me

You'll never listen to me
Ayyyee
Na na na na na na na na na noooo
